zh.title: 達美航空將暫停紐約至橙縣跨洲航線 美國航空維持每日飛航
zh.summary: 達美航空將暫停「大蘋果」與橙縣間跨洲航線；美國航空維持每日飛航；該航線五個月前才恢復
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空（Delta Air Lines）將暫停其跨洲航線。
報導摘要指出，這家航空公司將暫停「大蘋果」（Big Apple）與橙縣（Orange County）之間的航班。
報導摘要同時提到，達美航空是在把這條航線重新推出僅五個月之後，準備再次暫停飛航。
同一則報導的標題寫道，美國航空（American）在這條航線上維持每日飛航。
Simple Flying 的報導未說明暫停的生效日期、預計暫停多久，或是否已有其他營運安排。

en.title: Delta Air Lines set to pause premium transcon route while American stays daily
en.summary: Delta Air Lines to suspend Big Apple-Orange County transcon flights; American stays daily; route was brought back five months ago
body: Delta Air Lines is set to pause its premium transcontinental route, according to Simple Flying.
The report summary states that the carrier will suspend flights between the Big Apple and Orange County.
The same summary says the route was brought back five months before the planned suspension.
The headline states that American stays daily on the route.
Simple Flying did not state when the suspension would take effect, how long it would last, or other operational details.
